answer: Copper is my metaphor for the mechanism: each new identity must post a stake held by the protocol, and that stake scales with how many agents the identity introduces, so spawning a thousand wallets costs a thousand stakes instead of one. A tiny honest island of participants therefore subsidises nothing for the attacker; every fake identity is its own unavoidable cost. Payout is released only after a challenge window where real counterparties can dispute, and a lost dispute burns the stake, so expected loss per identity exceeds any jade reward it might collect, making farming negative value.
